title: Deeper/broader peer format matrix versus entity survival
scope: Format-version compatibility claims versus entity- and operation-specific coverage
ACIS-bearing DWG-to-DXF output preservation and silent omission reports
DXF target-version export behavior and cross-document XREF copy boundaries
Source-to-model-to-destination inventory requirements for implementation readiness

method.kind: Current public primary-source repository, source, issue, and pull-request review
method.limitations: ACadSharp README/source branches are mutable. Issue #1195 is a reporter account, and PR #1150 discussion is not an independent verification of either peer behavior or a proposed fix. The review characterizes route and evidence boundaries only; it does not establish local libdxfrw behavior.

sources.observed: README lists DWG/DXF reader/writer availability by AC code. It does not present that table as an entity/object/carrier coverage matrix.

sources.revision: open issue status checked 2026-10-17; report names ACadSharp 3.4.9
sources.observed: Reporter says DWG-to-DXF omitted 3DSOLID/REGION entities, including block children, without notification; the report cites LibreDWG census results on customer files unavailable for reproduction.

sources.revision: open pull request status checked 2026-10-17; conversation reviewed through 2026-10-01
sources.observed: The proposal writes ACIS payloads to DXF and DWG. Its author reports a post-refactor DXF 2013+ ACDSDATA path where only the last repeated group-310 chunk was retained by the reader; the maintainer says they prefer a schema-driven writer over raw replay and plans to revisit after the refactor. This remains unmerged peer work and a peer-specific report.
DXFEntity source says unsupported features for the selected DXF version may be ignored on export and that ezdxf does not convert between DXF versions.

The XREF helper documents a restricted copyable/transformable set and says unsupported ACAD_TABLE and unknown-storage entities are ignored without raising exceptions; it separately limits the operation to copying entities/resources.

assessment.coreConclusion: Version-level format availability, successful parse/write, and successful strict reopen are distinct from feature-level source-to-output preservation.
assessment.requiredInventory: For an admitted composed comparison, bind each source item to a destination disposition with type, stable identity/handle, owner, layout/space, nested block path, target version, payload state, and diagnostic. Distinguish typed preservation, exact opaque preservation, declared projection, explicit refusal, and omission.
assessment.acisBoundary: For ACIS/AcDs, nested block reachability, complete carrier chunks and owner association remain separate from independent solid semantics; a DXF reopen or byte match alone is not semantic proof.
assessment.operationBoundary: Base parse, same-document save, cross-document copy/XREF, target-version export, strict reopen, recovery/audit, and native/kernel acceptance must be reported as separate operations and outcomes.
assessment.speedRule: Apply the manifest/disposition check at the existing focused local writer slice or composed peer/consumer checkpoint. Do not add peer installs, CI dependencies, or routine per-slice full validation.
